title: Normal Aggregation
requiredChecks: Return one Project A row in the required six-column Markdown table.
Merge the repeated multi-day requirement-analysis work into outcomes rather than a day-by-day chronology.
State that requirement analysis was completed without duplicating the same confirmation work.
Keep this-week progress to no more than three concise bullets.
Use / for milestone and support; assessment must be / or one brief objective statement grounded only in the completed work.
automaticFailConditions: Lists Monday through Friday as a chronology.
Includes low-value routine details such as attending the regular meeting or replying to messages.
Creates an unsupported next-week task, milestone, owner, date, support request, or generic assessment.
Uses 按计划, 将完成, 将启动, 预计完成, 下周完成, 下周上线, or 下周交付 without explicit plan evidence.
Returns a preamble, postamble, code fence, reasoning, package summary, or duplicate report.
passRule: PASS only when every required check passes and no automatic fail condition occurs.
